title: Meeting Eric Davis, Hal Puthoff and Sonny White at a fusion conference
summary: Jack tells of Meeting Eric Davis, Hal Puthoff and Sonny White at a fusion conference, about an unknown time at an unknown place, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: A man named Jack says that while he was a graduate student researching fusion, the process of making energy by forcing atoms together, he went to a conference to present his work. He says that there he was introduced to three men named Eric Davis, Hal Puthoff and Sonny White. He tells it to show how he first came into contact with people tied to research on unusual advanced technology.
